name: myrsu-mcp
description: Single-company concentration risk analysis for tech workers with RSU comp. Risk score, action items, and historical drawdowns — all browser-local, no data leaves your machine.
long_description:
MyRSU lets your AI assistant answer the question every tech worker quietly worries about: **how concentrated is my wealth in my employer's stock?**

When you ask Claude about your RSU situation, this extension lets Claude run a real calculation — concentration percentage, Wealth-at-Risk, recommended max allocation, diversification gap, and a prioritized action plan. It also surfaces historical drawdowns for 40+ tech employers (NVDA, TSLA, MSFT, GOOGL, META, AAPL, AMZN, and many more) to ground the abstract numbers in real history.

**Privacy-first:** The MCP server runs locally and is stateless. No data is stored, logged, or transmitted to any server. All calculations happen on your machine.

**Companion to:** [myrsu.app](https://myrsu.app) — the free interactive web dashboard.

## Tools

- `myrsu_analyze_risk` — full risk analysis given any combination of wealth / income / employer inputs
- `myrsu_get_employer` — quick lookup of σ, drawdowns, and recommended caps for 40+ tech employers

## Example conversation

> *I work at NVIDIA. I have about $700K in NVDA stock, $300K cash and ETFs, earn $250K/yr. Am I dangerously concentrated?*

Claude calls `myrsu_analyze_risk` and responds with your Risk Score, the actions you should take, and the historical context (e.g., NVDA fell 66% in 2022 — what that would cost you today).

tools.name: myrsu_analyze_risk
tools.description: Calculate the Single-Company Risk Score (0-100) and full concentration analysis. Returns risk score, wealth-at-risk, diversification gap, top action items, historical drawdown context, and a pre-filled dashboard URL.

tools.name: myrsu_get_employer
tools.description: Look up annual volatility (σ), historical drawdowns, and recommended max concentration cap for 40+ tech employer presets (NVDA, TSLA, MSFT, GOOGL, META, AAPL, AMZN, plus SaaS / cloud / semis / consumer / fintech / mobility).
